text: {"lessons":["I tend to sell winners to lock in gains, but a sale should depend on the stock’s prospects and my portfolio plan, not just the comfort of realizing a profit.","Several sales at gains did not prevent my account value from falling overall; I should judge decisions by total portfolio performance and diversification, not isolated trades.","Losses feel especially painful, so I should set clear rebalancing and risk limits in advance rather than let regret or a desire to avoid selling at a loss drive my choices."]}
